seo.title: Sorlo Starter
seo.description: A site built on Sorlo, the open-source, schema-driven CMS.

blocks.text: Pages, posts and a contact form, edited in the CMS and served by Next.js.
blocks.heading: A site built on Sorlo

blocks.body:
This is the Sorlo starter. Every word and picture on this site comes from the CMS, so change anything in the admin, publish it, and it shows here.

The [blog](/blog) explains how the pieces fit together, starting with [Welcome to your Sorlo site](/blog/welcome-to-your-sorlo-site).

blocks.text: The contact form is a Sorlo form, which the site renders and the CMS keeps the submissions of.
blocks.label: Get in touch
blocks.heading: Questions about Sorlo?
